_comment: Canonical OAuth scope list — single source of truth. auth-server.js reads this at runtime; the scope-contract test asserts every skill's verb+endpoint is covered here; the doc permission tables (setup/AZURE_SETUP.md, setup/azure-setup-guide.html, skills/outlook-auth/reference.md, skills/outlook-setup/reference.md) must match this list. All scopes are delegated and user-consentable.
